governing_thought: Earth science claims are divided by what the claim is about, running from rock to settlement: materials, internal motion, deep time, surface and fluid envelopes, and human spatial organization.
rank_note: The pillars run from the solid rock of the planet outward through its motion, history and fluid surface to the human settlements on it.

pillars.title: Materials
pillars.statement: Materials are what the Earth is made of, namely the chemistry, minerals, rocks and fluids that compose it.

pillars.title: Internal motion
pillars.statement: Internal motion is the force, field and movement within the solid Earth that deforms, heats and shakes it.

pillars.title: Deep time
pillars.statement: Deep time is the history of the Earth, covering the age, layering, life and climate records preserved in its materials.

pillars.title: Surface and fluid envelopes
pillars.statement: Surface and fluid envelopes are the land surface, ice, waters and air that wrap the solid Earth, together with the means of observing them.

pillars.title: Human spatial organization
pillars.statement: Human spatial organization is how people locate, map, settle, use and manage places, and how they organize information about them.

method_line.title: Method line
method_line.covers: how the discipline is studied, taught and recorded
